ZAF.note: Only a planned national digital ID with regulatory readiness expected; the ETA is a travel authorisation, not an identity authentication service.
Planned Intelligent Population Register is mentioned without a stated link to civil registration records.
No count or share of the population holding a national ID is given.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
Nothing on other registers keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: Home Affairs says 372 participating bank branches now offer Smart ID services, through which more than half a million South Africans have accessed them, replacing the green barcoded ID book.
